cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Sr. Investment Strategist to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Job Responsibilities:
Takes a leading role on projects, working closely with internal stakeholders to understand key business issues, structure and perform complex analyses, and influence key decisions.
Synthesizes recommendations and understands their impact on the business.
Constructs executive-level presentations and presents complex findings in a clear, concise, and visually compelling manner.
Identifies company and competitor trends impacting the business and delivers insights to executives across the organization.
Builds financial and other decision-making models such as market share and business case estimates.
Works with cross-functional stakeholders to gain buy-in and drive change.
Coordinates cross-functional activities, such as Earnings Call and Board of Directors preparations.
Crafts messaging tailored to specific audiences including summarizing past performance results and future growth initiatives.
Supports strategy project leads on ad-hoc team deliverables.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor's Degree in Business, Management, Economics, Statistics, or related field
7-10 Years of management consulting, investment banking, corporate strategy, or other related experience requiring quantitative analysis and executive presentation skills
4-7 Years of strategy and problem solving experience in framing complex problems, identifying key issues that impact business decisions, and providing data-driven recommendations
4-7 Years of financial modeling and analytics experience, including developing financial models and performing financial and operating analysis and reporting
Strategy: Proactive problem solver who can break ambiguous problems into pieces using a hypothesis-driven approach. Ability to frame problems, use strategic frameworks, and develop strategies
Financial Analysis: Ability to build financial models and develop qualitative analysis, perform sensitivity analysis. Comfortable reading and understanding implications of income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements
Communication: Ability to synthesize analysis into succinct, executive-ready written, visual, and verbal communications. Ability to articulate rationale and present in front of senior leaders
At least 18 years of age
Legally authorized to work in [Location masked]
Preferred Requirements:
Master's/Advanced Degree (MBA) in Finance, Strategy, or Economics
Less than 2 years of prior experience in B2B, Product Strategy, and/or Telecom
Less than 2 years of project management experience, including managing projects independently, engaging stakeholders, and creating roadmaps and project plans
Business Acumen: Knowledge and understanding of business models, pricing strategies, and channel management. Analytical and data-driven, comfortable triangulating data to estimate market sizes and build financial models
Problem Solving: Ability to think through complex problems. Intellectually curious, enjoys researching new technologies and products
High Performance Teams: Team player, adept at working with others to overcome obstacles and gain alignment to achieve results
Project Management: Ability to think a few steps ahead and lay out thoughtful, achievable project plans. Understands how to engage others and what information and data is needed to achieve goals
Telecommunications: Knowledge of the wireless/telecom industry and technology sector

cond_0010.intro: [Company name masked] Strategy & Planning Team works with executive leaders from across the company to build business strategy. As the Sr. Investment Strategist, you focus on identifying growth opportunities for key products (e.g., Internet of Things), tracking market trends and competitors, and delivering insights on critical business decisions. This position works closely with Product, Finance, Marketing, Technology, and Sales.
cond_0010.responsibilities:
Takes a leading role on projects, working closely with internal stakeholders to understand key business issues, structure and perform complex analyses, and influence key decisions.
Synthesizes recommendations and understands their impact on the business.
Constructs executive-level presentations and presents complex findings in a clear, concise, and visually compelling manner.
Identifies company and competitor trends and delivers insights to executives across the organization.
Builds financial and other decision-making models such as market share and business case estimates.
Works with cross-functional stakeholders to gain buy-in and drive change.
Coordinates cross-functional activities, such as Earnings Call and Board of Directors preparations.
Crafts messaging tailored to specific audiences including summarizing past performance results and future growth initiatives.
Supports strategy project leads on ad-hoc team deliverables.
cond_0010.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree in Business, Management, Economics, Statistics, or related field.
Master's/Advanced Degree MBA – Finance, Strategy, Economics.
7-10 Years management consulting, investment banking, corporate strategy, or other related experience requiring quantitative analysis and executive presentation skills.
Less than 2 years prior experience in B2B, Product Strategy, and/or Telecom.
4-7 Years strategy and problem solving experience in framing complex problems, identifying key issues that impact business decisions and providing data driven recommendations.
4-7 Years financial modeling and analytics. Experience in developing financial models and performing financial and operating analysis and reporting, including analyzing complex data.
Less than 2 years project management. Experience managing projects independently, engaging and getting buy-in from stakeholders, creating roadmaps and project plans.
Strategy: Proactive problem solver who can break ambiguous problems into pieces using a hypothesis-driven approach. Ability to frame problems, use strategic frameworks, develop strategies.
Business Acumen: Knowledge and understanding of business models, pricing strategies, channel management. Analytical and data-driven, comfortable triangulating data to estimate market sizes and build financial models.
Financial Analysis: Ability to build financial models and develop qualitative analysis, perform sensitivity analysis. Comfortable reading and understanding implications of income statements, balance sheets, cash flow statements.
Communication: Ability to synthesize analysis into succinct, executive-ready written, visual, and verbal communications. Ability to articulate rationale and present in front of senior leaders. Effective communicator who knows how to bring structure and clarity to situations where direction is limited.
Problem Solving: Ability to think through complex problems. Intellectually curious, enjoys researching about new technologies and products.
Team player, adept at working with others to overcome obstacles and gain alignment to achieve results.
Project Management: Ability to think a few steps ahead, to lay out thoughtful and achievable project plans in a disciplined manner. Understand how to engage others and what information and data is needed to achieve goals.
Knowledge of the wireless/telecom industry and technology sector.
At least 18 years of age.

In this role, you will work alongside colleagues in Product, Finance, Marketing, Technology, and Sales to identify growth opportunities for key products (e.g., Internet of Things), track market trends and competitors, and help inform critical business decisions.
cond_0495.responsibilities:
Coordinate closely with internal stakeholders to understand key business issues, structure and perform complex analyses, and help shape key decisions.
Synthesize recommendations and work with the team to understand their impact on the business.
Collaborate on executive-level presentations and help communicate complex findings in a clear, concise, and visually compelling way.
Work with colleagues to identify company and competitor trends and share insights with executives across the organization.
Partner with cross-functional teams to build financial and other decision-making models, such as market share and business case estimates.
Engage cross-functional stakeholders to build alignment and support change together.
Help coordinate cross-functional activities, such as Earnings Call and Board of Directors preparations.
Work with relevant teams to craft messaging tailored to specific audiences, including summaries of past performance and future growth initiatives.
Support strategy project leads on ad-hoc team deliverables.
cond_0495.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Business, Management, Economics, Statistics, or related field
7-10 Years of experience in management consulting, investment banking, corporate strategy, or related work requiring quantitative analysis and executive presentation skills
4-7 Years of strategy and problem-solving experience: framing complex problems, identifying key issues that impact business decisions, and providing data-driven recommendations
4-7 Years of financial modeling and analytics experience, including developing financial models and performing financial and operating analysis on complex data
Ability to build financial models, perform sensitivity analysis, and read income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements
Ability to synthesize analysis into clear, executive-ready written, visual, and verbal communications
Proactive problem solver who can break ambiguous problems into pieces using a hypothesis-driven approach
Strong business acumen: knowledge of business models, pricing strategies, and channel management; comfortable triangulating data to estimate market sizes
At least 18 years of age
Legally authorized to work in [Location masked]
Preferred Requirements
Master's degree / MBA in Finance, Strategy, or Economics
Less than 2 years of prior experience in B2B, Product Strategy, and/or Telecom
Less than 2 years of project management experience: managing projects, engaging stakeholders, creating roadmaps and project plans
Knowledge of the wireless/telecom industry and technology sector
Intellectually curious, enjoys researching new technologies and products
Team player, adept at working with others to overcome obstacles and reach alignment
